  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/MapServer/mapfile.c","function":"msLoadMapFromString","line":6151,"var":"buffer","code":"mapObj *msLoadMapFromString(char *buffer, char *new_mappath)","note":"The mapfile text is parsed from the supplied buffer, so malformed PROJECTION blocks directly influence parser state."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/MapServer/mapfile.c","function":"loadMapInternal","line":6041,"var":"map->latlon","code":"if(loadProjection(&map->latlon) == -1) return MS_FAILURE;","note":"When the parser reaches a PROJECTION block, it dispatches to loadProjection for the current projection object."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/MapServer/mapfile.c","function":"loadProjection","line":1196,"var":"p->args[i]","code":"case(MS_STRING): p->args[i] = msStrdup(msyystring_buffer); i++;","note":"Each quoted token inside PROJECTION is duplicated into the projection argument array, and the index advances without a bounds check."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/MapServer/mapfile.c","function":"loadProjection","line":1203,"var":"p->args[i]","code":"default: msSetError(MS_IDENTERR, \"Parsing error near (%s):(line %d)\", \"loadProjection()\", msyystring_buffer, msyylineno);","note":"An invalid extra token after a valid projection definition forces the parser down the error path after the out-of-bounds write has already occurred."}
]
